name: jev-gate-compact
description: Answers auto compactions with an extractive digest and the recent tail, so compacting sends no summarizer request and has no wait; on by default.

enabled.title: Enable extractive compaction
enabled.description: Off registers no hook at all. Every compaction is the engine's own.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: build and log the digest, let the engine compact. active: compact with the digest; the engine's summarizer is not asked.

budgetChars.title: Budget (characters)
budgetChars.description: Characters for the digest and the kept recent messages together, 8000 to 400000.

compactSubagents.title: Subagents too
compactSubagents.description: Also answer a subagent's own auto compactions.

compactManual.title: Also /compact
compactManual.description: Also answer /compact typed without instructions. Off leaves /compact the engine's.
